classification.difficultyReason: Order signed fractions, mixed numbers and integers using their relative positions on a number line.

inlines.text: Arrange each set of numbers in increasing order.

answer.worked:
On a number line, $-\frac{7}{5}=-1\frac{2}{5}$ lies between $-2$ and $-1$. The positive numbers follow in the order $\frac14<\frac12<1$.

$$-2<-\frac75<-1<\frac14<\frac12<1$$

$-\frac{11}{5}=-2\frac15$ lies to the left of $-\frac74=-1\frac34$ on a number line. Both negative numbers precede $\frac14$ and $\frac72=3\frac12$.

$$-\frac{11}{5}<-\frac74<\frac14<\frac72$$

Compare the negative fractions using a common denominator:

$$-\frac{11}{12}=-\frac{55}{60},\qquad -\frac45=-\frac{48}{60},\qquad -\frac23=-\frac{40}{60}.$$

The most negative value lies furthest left; the positive fraction comes last.

$$-\frac{11}{12}<-\frac45<-\frac23<\frac{12}{13}$$
